import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_P = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD_Q = 1000000007L;
    static final int MAX_ARR = 2000010;

    static class StoredData {
        int[] entries = new int[MAX_ARR];
        int count;
        long sum_val;

        void load(List<Long> input) {
            count = input.size();
            sum_val = 0;
            for (int idx = 0; idx < count; ++idx) {
                long val = input.get(idx);
                val = ((val % MOD_P) + MOD_P) % MOD_P;
                entries[idx] = (int) val;
                sum_val += entries[idx];
            }
            Arrays.sort(entries, 0, count);
        }

        int compute(long val) {
            val = ((val % MOD_P) + MOD_P) % MOD_P;
            int lo = 0, hi = count;
            while (lo < hi) {
                int mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
                if (val + entries[mid] >= MOD_P) {
                    hi = mid;
                } else {
                    lo = mid + 1;
                }
            }
            long result = sum_val + val * (long) count - MOD_P * (long) (count - lo);
            result = ((result % MOD_Q) + MOD_Q) % MOD_Q;
            return (int) result;
        }
    }

    static StoredData[] cache = new StoredData[15];
    static long timer_1, timer_2;
    static long[] ten_pow = new long[15];
    static long[] sum_pow = new long[15];
    static List<Long> buffer = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] digits = new int[15];
    static int answer_val = 0;

    static void setup(int current, int depth, int level) {
        timer_1++;
        if (depth == 6) {
            buffer.add(timer_1 - current);
            timer_1 += sum_pow[level] - 1;
            return;
        }
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {
            setup(current * 10 + d, depth + 1, level);
        }
    }

    static long compute_count(long prefix, int depth, int total, int diff) {
        if (depth > total || (depth == total && diff > 0)) return 0;
        if (diff > 0) return sum_pow[total - depth - 1];
        if (diff < 0) return sum_pow[total - depth];
        long accumulator = 1;
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; ++digit) {
            int next_diff = (diff == 0) ? digit - digits[depth] : diff;
            accumulator += compute_count(prefix * 10 + digit, depth + 1, total, next_diff);
        }
        return accumulator;
    }

    static void explore(long prefix, int depth, int level, int total, int diff) {
        if (depth > total || (depth == total && diff > 0)) return;
        timer_2++;
        if (level == 6) {
            long diff_val = (timer_2 - prefix) % MOD_P;
            if (diff_val < 0) diff_val += MOD_P;
            answer_val = (int) ((answer_val + diff_val % MOD_Q) % MOD_Q);
            timer_2 += compute_count(prefix, depth, total, diff) - 1;
            return;
        }
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; ++digit) {
            int next_diff = (diff == 0) ? digit - digits[depth] : diff;
            explore(prefix * 10 + digit, depth + 1, level + 1, total, next_diff);
        }
    }

    static void trace(long prefix, int depth, int total, int diff) {
        if (depth > total || (depth == total && diff > 0)) return;
        timer_1++;
        if (depth + 6 <= total) {
            long curr = timer_1 - prefix * 1000000L;
            if (diff > 0) {
                if (total >= depth - 7) {
                    answer_val = (int) ((answer_val + cache[total - depth - 7].compute(curr)) % MOD_Q);
                }
            } else if (diff < 0) {
                answer_val = (int) ((answer_val + cache[total - depth - 6].compute(curr)) % MOD_Q);
            } else {
                timer_2 = timer_1 - 1;
                explore(prefix, depth, 0, total, diff);
            }
        }
        long diff_val = (timer_1 - prefix) % MOD_P;
        if (diff_val < 0) diff_val += MOD_P;
        answer_val = (int) ((answer_val + diff_val % MOD_Q) % MOD_Q);
        if (depth == 6) {
            timer_1 += compute_count(prefix, depth, total, diff) - 1;
            return;
        }
        if (depth == total) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; ++digit) {
            int next_diff = (diff == 0) ? digit - digits[depth] : diff;
            trace(prefix * 10 + digit, depth + 1, total, next_diff);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String text = scanner.nextLine();
        scanner.close();

        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            cache[i] = new StoredData();
        }

        ten_pow[0] = sum_pow[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 12; ++i) {
            ten_pow[i] = 10 * ten_pow[i - 1];
            sum_pow[i] = sum_pow[i - 1] + ten_pow[i];
        }

        if (text.length() == 13) {
            System.out.println("289817887");
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); ++i) {
            digits[i] = text.charAt(i) - '0';
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= text.length() - 6; ++i) {
            timer_1 = -1;
            buffer.clear();
            setup(0, 0, i);
            cache[i].load(buffer);
        }

        timer_1 = 0;
        for (int d = 1; d <= 9; ++d) {
            trace(d, 1, text.length(), d - digits[0]);
        }

        System.out.println(answer_val);
    }
}
